purpose: Unscored held-out physical build/test command counts. This determines whether the compiler improvement generalizes to a separate behavioral Ruff edit. Counts, failed checks and neutral outcomes are reported. No wall-time estimate is taken from these traced commands.
assertions: two ordinary setup commands and a fresh JSON command for each arm
reverse the full historical commit and restore its original bytes, permissions and timestamps, retaining the index bytes
cargo build and cargo test --no-run use the ordinary profile, --locked --offline, equal logical paths and eight CPU jobs
Ruff check --select B006,B008 on two default values switches B006 to B008 on edit and restores B006 after restoring the source
All 501 or 619 units must be fresh immediately after edit and restoration. Compare full rustc, link-only rustc and Wild rosters in both repetitions, and every native executable roster.
